question: Can separately trained models pass a generated answer into a second addition when both operand pairs were left out of training?

selection.rule: Include every training run with at least 40 of 46 development pairs correct.

first_step: Each source model adds all 46 test pairs and draws the answer.
second_step: For each first answer, choose the lexicographically first test pair containing that answer. Replace the matching operand image with the source model's generated answer.
controls: For every receiving model, repeat the second step with the target first-answer image.
matrix: Evaluate all nine ordered source-receiver pairs, including three diagonal controls and six pairs of separately trained models.
primary_counts: correct generated first answers that fail only after substitution
correct generated first answers that repair a canonical-input failure
